factory.title: Factory & Quality
factory.hero_subtitle: A trusted candy manufacturer with 15+ years of experience serving global brands
factory.about_p1: Founded in 2008, our candy factory has grown from a local manufacturer to a trusted OEM partner for brands worldwide. We specialize in gummy candy, hard candy, aerated candy, toffee, and compound chocolate products.
factory.about_p2: Our facility spans 20,000 square meters and is equipped with state-of-the-art production lines capable of producing 100 tons of candy daily. We serve clients across Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
